text:
mira: Heads up — sample app (workers) started failing after the v2 SDK publish. Error in Cloudflare Workers: "No matching export for "./client.js" in "@redwood/inference" package.json"

devon: ugh. can you paste the import you used? repro link?

mira: minimal repro: `import Inference from '@redwood/inference';` in the worker entry. package.json currently has exports like: `"exports": { "./node": "./dist/node/index.js", "./browser": "./dist/browser/index.js" }` — Worker runtime doesn't match those conditionals so it falls through. also noticed no `types` subpath exported, so TS breaks too.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI sample-app-edge / build #289 failed (exit code 1) — logs: "ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED"

tyler: quick workaround is to add a fallback entry or a `./worker` conditional, e.g. `"./worker": "./dist/worker/index.mjs"` or add a plain `"./*": "./dist/*.js"` style crowd-pleaser (but that bloats package).

samir: looks like the release script removed the legacy `main`/`module` fields when we switched to strict exports. publishing tool only emitted node/browser keys. didn’t account for Edge/Workers or bundlers that rely on bare imports.

alexa: also seeing auth retries not firing in the worker repro — maybe the fetch wrapper isn't getting overridden in the ESM worker build. Auth header code is coming from a different entrypoint than expected due to the exports change.

devon: could we patch release with an extra `./worker` subpath and add `types` exports? Then cut a patch (v2.0.1) and ship. Also add a sample-app CI test that runs on a workers-like environment.

mira: on it. I'll open a revert-ish patch that restores a minimal set of fallback exports + add `types` subpath. created PR #421 (WIP). Adding a smoke job for sample-apps/edge that imports the sdk and does a simple generate call. cc @tyler @samir for review.

tyler: sgtm. please also add a tiny test that imports `export * from './types'` so the TS consumers pick it up. :thumbsup:

samir: we'll also update the release script to emit `./worker` and a `default` fallback in future releases and add a changelog note for edge runtime compatibility.

mira: thanks — tracking doc in the PR. will ping when patch is published and sample-app CI is green.
